title: Chinese Character Triplets
synopsis: Learn some Chinese characters that are made up of three identical parts.

fullText.simplified:
三胞胎汉字

    汉字是世界上最古老的文字之一。今天给大家介绍三个一样的字组成的新汉字，以及它们有趣的意思。
    三个“金”字组成的汉字是鑫，是有很多钱的意思，多用作店铺名字和人名。
    三个“木”字是森，从这三个木就可以看出来它是很多树的意思。可以组词“森林”。
    三个“水”是淼，和“森”一样，一看到这个汉字就能猜出来是水多的意思。
    三个“火”是焱，是火焰的意思。
    三个“土”是垚，意思是山很高。现在常常是人的名字。
    了解中国文化的人都知道，中国人有“金木水火土”五行的说法，所以人们给刚出生的孩子起名字的时候，会根据孩子的出生年份，再参考五行查询表，给孩子起一个合适的名字。俗话说缺什么补什么。比如如果一个孩子命里缺“水”，他的父母可能给他一个“淼”字的名字。这样父母觉得可以让孩子一生幸运健康。
    怎么样？是不是挺有意思的？
fullText.traditional:
三胞胎漢字

    漢字是世界上最古老的文字之一。今天給大家介紹三個一樣的字組成的新漢字，以及它們有趣的意思。
    三個“金”字組成的漢字是鑫，是有很多錢的意思，多用作店鋪名字和人名。
    三個“木”字是森，從這三個木就可以看出來它是很多樹的意思。可以組詞“森林”。
    三個“水”是淼，和“森”一樣，一看到這個漢字就能猜出來是水多的意思。
    三個“火”是焱，是火焰的意思。
    三個“土”是垚，意思是山很高。現在常常是人的名字。
    瞭解中國文化的人都知道，中國人有“金木水火土”五行的說法，所以人們給剛出生的孩子起名字的時候，會根據孩子的出生年份，再參考五行查詢表，給孩子起一個合適的名字。俗話說缺什麼補什麼。比如如果一個孩子命裡缺“水”，他的父母可能給他一個“淼”字的名字。這樣父母覺得可以讓孩子一生幸運健康。
    怎麼樣？是不是挺有意思的？

Today I will introduce to you Chinese characters made up of three identical characters, along with their fascinating meanings.

raw.synopsis: Learn some Chinese characters that are made up of three identical parts.
sentence_translations: Chinese characters are one of the most ancient writing systems in the world.
Today I will introduce to you Chinese characters made up of three identical characters, along with their fascinating meanings.
The Chinese character made up of three characters for gold is “xin”.
It means extremely wealthy and is mostly used in names for shops and people.
The Chinese character made up of three characters for wood is "sen".
From these three wood characters, it can be seen that it means many trees, and we can make the word "senlin" (forest).
Three water characters are "miao", and like "sen", one can guess right upon seeing this character that it means a lot of water.
Three fire characters are "yan", which means flame.
Three earth characters are "yao", which means a mountain is very tall. Now, it is commonly used in people's names.
As everyone who understands Chinese culture knows, ..
.. Chinese people have the concept of the five elements of "metal, wood, water, fire, and earth".
So, when people name their newborn children, ..
.. they will find a suitable name taking into account the child's year of birth and then referencing the five elements chart.
As the saying goes, make up for what is missing.
For instance, if a child’s fate is lacking “water”, then his parents might give him a name with the character “miao” in it.
His parents feel that this way their child will be fortunate and healthy for life.
What do you think? Isn't it quite fascinating?
